title: Tenant protection plan compliance inspections.
officialText:
For buildings undergoing work for which a tenant protection plan is required by Article 120 of Title 28 of the Administrative Code, inspections shall be made by the department to determine compliance with the tenant protection plan.
*Section 110.3.7 was amended by Local Law 154 of 2017. This law has an effective date of December 28, 2017.
**Section 110.3.7 was amended by Local Law 106 of 2019. This law has an effective date of March 8, 2020.
